c_allocation_diagnostic.definition: Matched 32-warmup, gate-bracketed, serial confirmable loopback native reads; body, ETag, wire shape and one authenticated Echo retry verified; unpaced spin client.
c_allocation_diagnostic.host_overlap: All 24 windows overlapped the single-job ESP offline build. The six paired rounds consistently favored right-sizing.

longer_800.host_observation: A separate single-job ESP SDK build entered ninja during the first pair. Retain all 8 pairs as a secondary cohort.

direct_stock_and_right_sized.wire_shape: All arms verify exactly two datagrams each way per block, identical body and ETag, separate confirmation. Libcoap clients perform one authenticated Echo retry before timing, Coaptic does not require it.
direct_stock_and_right_sized.measurements: All six permutations of the three arms per body, 32 warmups; 1 outstanding, unpaced, payload verified same native spinning client.

client_build_note: The same release client served all timed builds. A later verifier tightened untimed Echo option validation and budget preflight. Its independent post-change eight-cell qualification is listed separately.

isolated_trial.decision: Rejected. Unprotected capacity improved. Protected blockwise median latency rose in all six capacity pairs.

first_borrow_decision: Rejected. Default protected blockwise latency rose, and longer paced unprotected CPU results split.
